reviews.text: Papa ne bola bank wale credit report ke baare mein kuch puch rahe the and unko samajh nahi aa raha tha kya check karna hai. Maine Paisabazaar pe unki report open karke basic details samjhai. Hindi mein dekhne se aur easy ho gaya. Ab unko bhi idea hai ki score ke alawa report mein kya cheezein important hoti hain.

Mere cousin ne bola ki uska credit score suddenly down ho gaya hai. Maine usko Paisabazaar pe full report check karne bola. Report dekhne ke baad usko recent enquiries ka idea mila jo woh bhool gaya tha. Tab mujhe bhi samajh aaya ki credit score ke peeche actual details dekhna kitna important hai.

Mujhe laga tha credit score matlab CIBIL score hi hota hai. Paisabazaar pe CIBIL ke saath Experian, Equifax aur CRIF scores bhi check kar sakte hain. Mere scores the same nahi the, which was actually interesting. Ab credit profile dekhte time sirf ek bureau ke score pe depend nahi karta.

Paisabazaar helped me find a low-interest personal loan when I had an urgent medical emergency. My score was decent, and the app immediately showed me pre-approved offers from reliable NBFC partners. The interface made it simple to compare EMIs and processing charges side-by-side. I secured the funds in less than 24 hours with minimum paperwork. Truly a lifesaver in tough times!
Paisabazaar makes credit reports less confusing. The important information is presented in a way that is easy to follow.

780 ka CIBIL score dekh ke pehle bas khush ho jata tha. Ek din detailed credit report download karke properly dekhi toh payment history, credit accounts aur enquiries ka idea hua. Score se zyada report useful lagi because pata chalta hai credit history actually kaisi hai.

I recently finished paying an old consumer loan and wanted to see how my credit profile looked afterwards. I checked my credit score on Paisabazaar and downloaded the detailed credit report. The report summary made it easier to quickly review my accounts and repayment information. I'll probably keep tracking my score monthly now.

Main aur meri wife compare kar rahe the ki kiska credit score better hai. Paisabazaar pe dono ke scores check kiye aur phir reports dekhi. Sirf score compare karne ke bajay payment history aur accounts dekhne ke baad difference samajh aaya. Turns out credit habits ka impact kaafi visible hota hai.

Randomly credit report check kar raha tha and ek enquiry dikhi jo mujhe yaad nahi thi. Pehle thoda tension hua, but report ki details dekhne ke baad samajhne ki koshish ki ki enquiry kis period me hui thi. Tab realise hua ki sirf score check karna enough nahi, report monitor karna bhi important hai.

My brother was planning to apply for a personal loan and wanted to understand his credit profile first. He had the detailed credit report but didn't know where to start. We opened PB VCR on the Paisabazaar app and the personalised video explained the important points one by one. I liked the actionable tips at the end because they gave him an idea of what to focus on before making another credit application. For first-time borrowers, this kind of visual explanation can be really helpful.

Maine apna credit report Hindi mein open karke dekha because financial terms English mein kabhi-kabhi confusing lagte hain. Surprisingly kaafi cheezein easily samajh aa gayi. Payment history aur account details dekhne mein bhi problem nahi hui. credit score check karna toh simple hai, but report ko apni comfortable language mein padhna aur better laga.

My sister was checking her credit report and got confused by terms related to credit utilisation, repayment history and enquiries. Instead of explaining everything myself, I suggested trying PB VCR on Paisabazaar. The personalised video helped explain the important parts of her credit profile in simple language. She was able to understand what was affecting her score without spending time searching for the meaning of every term separately.

I usually check my credit score from my phone so the mobile experience matters to me. Paisabazaar app is easy to scroll through and the information is presented in a way that doesn't feel too cluttered. Overall it feels comfortable to use even for a quick check.

Pehle Paisabazaar pe score check karta tha and bas number dekh ke app band. Credit Health Pro use karne ke baad detailed analysis mila ki credit health ko kaunse parameters affect kar rahe hain. Personalised action plan aur expert guidance ki wajah se mujhe actual improvement ke liye direction mili, sirf score dekhne tak baat nahi rahi.

Kuch time pehle credit card ka outstanding clear kiya tha aur check karna tha ki credit score update hua ya nahi. Paisabazaar pe score refresh karke dobara check kiya. At least ab mujhe samajh aa gaya ki score ko regularly monitor karna useful hai instead of randomly check karne ke.

Very disappointing experiences — I am extremely disappointed with this bank’s approach to my Loan Against Property application. I am ready to provide my property as security, yet the bank is creating unnecessary issues based on old problems that were already resolved years ago. Even after offering property as collateral, I am facing repeated objections and unnecessary delays. A bank should look at the customer’s current financial position, repayment capacity, and available security, rather than judging someone based on issues from the past. Customers also have emotions, financial responsibilities, and genuine needs. Unfortunately, I feel that this bank has failed to understand that.
